area: Your app: its install, its user and its doors
description: A shop's own field rule, checked on every save of its record type: Desk form, import or API. Only a System Manager keeps these.

fields.description: A name a person reads, for example: Item short code is upper alphanumeric.
fields.label: Rule name

fields.description: The record type whose every save this rule checks: a Desk form, an import or an API call.
fields.label: Record type

fields.description: Optional: the field name of the table whose rows the rule checks, for example items.
fields.label: Table

fields.description: The check: pattern, length, derived, unique_in_rows, threshold, required_when, locked_in_state, unique_across, role_for_action or count_per_day.
fields.label: Kind

fields.description: The field the rule reads; for a derived rule, the field it writes.
fields.label: Field

fields.description: refuse: stops the save with the message. flag: saves and adds a row to Sales to review. Till sales are only flagged.
fields.label: When the rule is broken

fields.description: Rules run lowest first, so one derived value can feed the next rule.
fields.label: Sequence

fields.description: What the person saving sees, at most 140 characters. Empty: a plain sentence for the kind.
fields.label: Message

fields.description: A named shape, or leave it empty and write a pattern.
fields.label: Shape

fields.description: Wrap in ^ and $. Max 100 characters and two repeats or choices (* + ? {m,n} |). No nested repeats, back-references or look-arounds. Values up to 140.
fields.label: Pattern

fields.description: scale: source × factor + offset. days_until: days from today to the source date. percent: source ÷ second source × 100. sum_rows: the source field added up over the rows of a table. count_rows: the number of a table's rows that meet the conditions. days_between: the days from the source date to the second source date (creation may be the source on a rule without a table). Rounded as set below.
fields.label: Formula

fields.description: sum_rows and count_rows: the field name of the table whose rows are added up or counted, for example items. The figure is written on the record itself.
fields.label: Rows of table

fields.description: scale and sum_rows: the number. percent: the part. days_until: the date. days_between: the earlier date, or creation (when the record was made).
fields.label: Source field

fields.description: percent: the whole. days_between: the later date. Either source empty (or a percent's base 0): the figure is cleared.
fields.label: Second source field

fields.description: Judge the limit when the record is new, is submitted, or the field's value changed; a row of a table when it is new or its value changed. An edit that leaves the value as it was is not judged.
fields.label: Judge only when new or changed

fields.description: Optional: read the limit from a settings record someone else may edit: a record type your package installed, or Stock Settings, Selling Settings or Buying Settings. The rule itself stays with a System Manager.
fields.label: Limit from record type

fields.description: The settings record's name, as written. A single record's name is its record type. The record need not exist yet: until it does, the Value above is used.
fields.label: Limit from record

fields.description: Its number field holding the limit. 0 or empty: the Value above is used.
fields.label: Limit field

fields.description: Optional: its field naming one role that may pass the limit, used instead of the roles below. Empty: the roles below. All, Guest, Desk User and Administrator are ignored.
fields.label: Role field

fields.description: The action only the roles below may take, on every door: the Desk, an import and the API.
fields.label: Action

fields.description: One role per line. threshold: a person holding any of them saves past the limit. role_for_action: only a person holding one of them may take the action.
fields.label: Roles that may pass it

fields.description: All must hold, at most three. required_when: then required. role_for_action: then a role is needed (none: always). count_per_day: what counts.
fields.label: When all of these hold

fields.description: One state per line. Once a record is saved in one of them, the fields below are locked.
fields.label: From these workflow states on

fields.description: One field name per line (a table field locks its rows).
fields.label: Locked fields

fields.description: Optional: one field name per line, for example company. The value may repeat on a record whose scope fields differ. A cancelled record never holds a value.
fields.label: Within the same

fields.description: One field of the record: each of its values has its own count, such as each store.
fields.label: Counted per

fields.description: A Date or Date and time field: a record counts on its calendar day, in the site's time zone.
fields.label: Day from

fields.description: A record that newly meets every condition is refused once this many have been counted that day (1 to 10,000).
fields.label: At most per day

lede: A rule a record must meet when it is saved, applied by iVendNext itself. A manifest installs it.
name: Retail Save Rule

fields.description: For in: up to 10 values, separated by commas (count_per_day rules only).
fields.label: Value

why: contract save_rules; recipe event_feed; recipe save_rules
